the complete Quran text in the requested script. class="clean-btn tocCollapsibleButton_TO0P">On this page</button></div><div class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><div class="row"><div class="col col--12"><h1>Page Layout API Guide</h1><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="introduction">Introduction<a class="hash-link" href="#introduction" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="what-is-the-pages-lookup-api">What is the Pages Lookup API?<a class="hash-link" href="#what-is-the-pages-lookup-api" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The Pages Lookup API provides information about how Quranic content is paginated across different Mushaf (Quran print) editions. Since different Mushafs have different page layouts, the same verse can appear on different pages depending on which Mushaf you&#x27;re using.</p><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="why-is-this-important">Why is This Important?<a class="hash-link" href="#why-is-this-important" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><ul><li><strong>Accurate Navigation</strong>: Navigate to specific Mushaf pages correctly</li><li><strong>Consistent Display</strong>: Show page numbers that match physical copies</li><li><strong>Mushaf Variety</strong>: Support multiple Mushaf styles (IndoPak, Uthmani, etc.)</li><li><strong>Reading Progress</strong>: Track reading progress by actual Mushaf pages</li></ul><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="tldr---quick-decision-guide">TL;DR - Quick Decision Guide<a class="hash-link" href="#tldr---quick-decision-guide" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><table><thead><tr><th>You Want To...</th><th>Use This Endpoint</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Get pages for a chapter</td><td><code>/pages/lookup?chapter_number=2&amp;mushaf=1</code></td><td>Al-Baqarah in QCF V2</td></tr><tr><td>Get pages for a Juz</td><td><code>/pages/lookup?juz_number=1&amp;mushaf=1</code></td><td>Juz 1</td></tr><tr><td>Get verses for a specific page</td><td><code>/verses/by_page/50?mushaf=1</code></td><td>Page 50</td></tr><tr><td>Get verse range on a page</td><td>Use Pages Lookup response</td><td>See examples</td></tr></tbody></table><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="quick-start">Quick Start<a class="hash-link" href="#quick-start" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="1-choose-your-mushaf">1. id="view-modes-reading-view-vs-translation-view">View Modes: Reading View vs Translation View<a class="hash-link" href="#view-modes-reading-view-vs-translation-view" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>When building a Quran application, you&#x27;ll typically implement one of two view modes:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th>Reading View</th><th>Translation View</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>Layout Unit</strong></td><td>Mushaf page (lines)</td><td>Single verse</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Data Grouping</strong></td><td>Words → Lines → Pages</td><td>Verses (no grouping)</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Line Construction</strong></td><td>Required</td><td>Not applicable</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Use Case</strong></td><td>Physical Mushaf layout</td><td>Study with translations</td></tr></tbody></table><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="reading-view-from-api-response-to-rendered-page">Reading View: From API Response to Rendered Page<a class="hash-link" href="#reading-view-from-api-response-to-rendered-page" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The API returns <strong>verses</strong>, but Reading View needs <strong>lines</strong> to match the physical Mushaf layout.</p><p><strong>Why?</strong> A single Mushaf line often contains words from multiple verses. You must group by line, not by verse.</p><p><strong>Word Layout Properties:</strong></p><p>Each word includes:</p><ul><li><code>page_number</code>: Which Mushaf page (1-604)</li><li><code>line_number</code>: Which line on that page (1-15 typically)</li><li><code>position</code>: Word order within the verse</li></ul><blockquote><p><strong>Note:</strong> The API returns words in correct Mushaf order, so no sorting is needed—just group by line.</p></blockquote><p><strong>Data Transformation (Pseudo-code):</strong></p><div class="language-text codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color:#393A34;--prism-background-color:#f6f8fa"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-text codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 1: Extract all words from all verses (already in correct order)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">words = verses.flatMap(verse =&gt; verse.words)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain" style="display:inline-block"></span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 2: Group words by page and line (order is preserved)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">lines = groupBy(words, word =&gt; `page-${page_number}-line-${line_number}`)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Result: { &quot;page-1-line-1&quot;: [words], &quot;page-1-line-2&quot;: [words], ... }</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain" style="display:inline-block"></span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 3: Render each line, then render words within each line</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">for each line in lines:</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">    for each word in line:</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">        render word with font based on page_number</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" title="Copy" class="clean-btn"><span class="copyButtonIcons_eSgA" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="copyButtonIcon_y97N" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path id="️-important-do-not-store-files-locally">⚠️ Important: Do Not Store Files Locally<a class="hash-link" href="#️-important-do-not-store-files-locally" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><blockquote><p><strong>We strongly recommend against downloading and storing font files, JSON data, or other assets locally in your application.</strong></p><p><strong>Why?</strong></p><ul><li>Font files and data are periodically updated with corrections, improvements, and new features</li><li>Locally stored files will become outdated without your knowledge</li><li>You may end up serving incorrect or stale Quranic content to your users</li></ul><p><strong>Best Practice:</strong> Always load fonts and data directly from the CDN at runtime. The CDN is fast, reliable, and ensures your users always receive the latest, most accurate content.</p></blockquote><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="rendering-qcf-fonts-v1-v2-v4">Rendering QCF Fonts (V1, V2, V4)<a class="hash-link" href="#rendering-qcf-fonts-v1-v2-v4" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><p>QCF fonts require special class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="layout-behavior-changes">Layout Behavior Changes<a class="hash-link" href="#layout-behavior-changes" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>When implementing a Reading View that aims to replicate physical Mushaf pages, consider these layout behaviors:</p><h4 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="maintaining-mushaf-page-boundaries">Maintaining Mushaf Page Boundaries<a class="hash-link" href="#maintaining-mushaf-page-boundaries" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h4><p>At smaller font scales (1-3), you can maintain <strong>physical Mushaf page boundaries</strong>:</p><ul><li>Each line matches the same boundaries as the physical Mushaf</li><li>Page breaks align with printed Mushaf pages</li><li>Words don&#x27;t overflow their designated line positions</li></ul><p>This creates an interleaved reading experience that closely mirrors reading from a physical Quran.</p><h4 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="big-text-layout-mode">Big Text Layout Mode<a class="hash-link" href="#big-text-layout-mode" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h4><p>At larger font scales (4+), it becomes impossible to maintain exact print fidelity. Consider switching to a relaxed layout:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th>Normal Layout (Scale 1-3)</th><th>Big Text Layout (Scale 4+)</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Line boundaries</td><td>Strictly maintained</td><td>Relaxed for readability</td></tr><tr><td>Page fidelity</td><td>Matches physical Mushaf</td><td>May differ from print</td></tr><tr><td>Word wrapping</td><td>Preserves Mushaf line breaks</td><td>Allows natural wrapping</td></tr><tr><td>Primary goal</td><td>Authenticity</td><td>Accessibility</td></tr></tbody></table><p><strong>Implementation tip:</strong> Track when users select large font sizes and adjust your layout constraints accordingly:</p><div class="language-javascript codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color:#393A34;--prism-background-color:#f6f8fa"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre the complete Quran text in the requested script. Use the structural filters to limit results to a chapter, juz, hizb, rub el hizb, manzil, ruku, or page.</p><details style="margin-bottom:1rem" data-collapsed="false" open="" class="details_lb9f alert alert--info details_b_Ee"><summary><strong>Path Parameters</strong></summary><div><div class="collapsibleContent_i85q"><div><ul><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>script</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->string</span><strong class="paramsRequired_UKPH"> required</strong><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> [<code>uthmani</code>, <code>uthmani_simple</code>, <code>text_uthmani_simple</code>, <code>uthmani_tajweed</code>, <code>text_uthmani_tajweed</code>, <code>indopak</code>, <code>text_indopak</code>, <code>indopak_nastaleeq</code>, <code>text_indopak_nastaleeq</code>, <code>imlaei</code>, <code>text_imlaei</code>, <code>imlaei_simple</code>, <code>text_imlaei_simple</code>, <code>qpc_hafs</code>, <code>text_qpc_hafs</code>, <code>qpc_nastaleeq</code>, <code>text_qpc_nastaleeq</code>, <code>code_v1</code>, <code>v1</code>, <code>code_v2</code>, <code>v2</code>, <code>v1_image</code>]</p></div><div><p>Script identifier for the response payload. Supported values: <code>uthmani</code>, <code>uthmani_simple</code>, <code>text_uthmani_simple</code>, <code>uthmani_tajweed</code>, <code>text_uthmani_tajweed</code>, <code>indopak</code>, <code>text_indopak</code>, <code>indopak_nastaleeq</code>, <code>text_indopak_nastaleeq</code>, <code>imlaei</code>, <code>text_imlaei</code>, <code>imlaei_simple</code>, <code>text_imlaei_simple</code>, <code>qpc_hafs</code>, <code>text_qpc_hafs</code>, <code>qpc_nastaleeq</code>, <code>text_qpc_nastaleeq</code>, <code>code_v1</code>, <code>v1</code>, <code>code_v2</code>, <code>v2</code>, <code>v1_image</code>. Unsupported values fall back to the Uthmani text payload.</p></div></div></ul></div></div></div></details><details style="margin-bottom:1rem" data-collapsed="false" open="" class="details_lb9f alert class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><div class="row theme-api-markdown"><div class="col col--7"><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="get-uthmani-simple-script-of-ayah">Get Uthmani simple script of ayah<a class="hash-link" href="#get-uthmani-simple-script-of-ayah" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><p>Get Uthmani simple script(without tashkiq/diacritical marks) of ayah. Use query strings to filter results, leave all query string blank if you want to fetch script of whole Quran.</p><details style="margin-bottom:1rem" data-collapsed="false" open="" class="details_lb9f alert alert--info details_b_Ee"><summary><strong>Query Parameters</strong></summary><div><div class="collapsibleContent_i85q"><div><ul><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>chapter_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 114</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get Uthmani script of a specific surah.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>juz_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 30</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get Uthmani script of a specific juz.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>page_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 604</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get Uthmani script of a Madani Mushaf page</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>hizb_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 60</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get Uthmani script of a specific hizb.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>rub_el_hizb_number</strong><span class="hash-link" href="#get-a-single-translation" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><p>Get a single Translation of all ayah.</p><p>See <a query string.</p><details style="margin-bottom:1rem" data-collapsed="false" open="" class="details_lb9f alert alert--info details_b_Ee"><summary><strong>Path Parameters</strong></summary><div><div id.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>foot_notes</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->boolean</span><div><p>If true, includes a <code>foot_notes</code> map inside each -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 114</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get translation of a specific surah.</p></div></div><div 30</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get translation of a specific juz.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>page_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><div class="row theme-api-markdown"><div class="col col--7"><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="get-a-single-tafsir">Get a single tafsir<a class="hash-link" href="#get-a-single-tafsir" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><p>Get a single Tafsir of all ayah.</p><p>See <a href="/docs/content_apis_versioned/tafsirs/">/resources/tafsirs</a> endpoint to fetch available tafsirs.</p><p>You can also include more fields of tafsir using <code>fields</code> query string.</p><details style="margin-bottom:1rem" data-collapsed="false" open="" class="details_lb9f alert alert--info details_b_Ee"><summary><strong>Path Parameters</strong></summary><div><div class="collapsibleContent_i85q"><div><ul><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>tafsir_id</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->number</span><strong class="paramsRequired_UKPH"> required</strong><div><p>tafsir id</p></div></div></ul></div></div></div></details><details style="margin-bottom:1rem" data-collapsed="false" open="" class="details_lb9f alert alert--info details_b_Ee"><summary><strong>Query Parameters</strong></summary><div><div class="collapsibleContent_i85q"><div><ul><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>fields</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->string</span><div><p>comma separated fields of tafsir.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>chapter_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 114</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get tafsir of a specific surah.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>juz_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 30</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get tafsir of a specific juz.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>page_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 604</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get tafsir of a Madani Mushaf page</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>hizb_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 60</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get tafsir of a specific hizb.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>rub_el_hizb_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= 240</code></p></div><div><p>If you want to get tafsir of a specific Rub el Hizb.</p></div></div><div class="paramsItem_PKlE"><strong>manzil_number</strong><span class="schemaName_MpGo"> <!-- -->integer</span><div><p><strong>Possible values:</strong> <code>&gt;= 1</code> and <code>&lt;= Rendered Page<a class="hash-link" href="#reading-view-from-api-response-to-rendered-page" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The API returns <strong>verses</strong>, but Reading View needs <strong>lines</strong> to match the physical Mushaf layout.</p><p><strong>Why?</strong> A single Mushaf line often contains words from multiple verses. You must group by line, not by verse.</p><p><strong>Word Layout Properties:</strong></p><p>Each word includes:</p><ul><li><code>page_number</code>: Which Mushaf page (1-604)</li><li><code>line_number</code>: Which line on that page (1-15 typically)</li><li><code>position</code>: Word order within the verse</li></ul><blockquote><p><strong>Note:</strong> The API returns words in correct Mushaf order, so no sorting is needed—just group by line.</p></blockquote><p><strong>Data Transformation (Pseudo-code):</strong></p><div class="language-text codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color:#393A34;--prism-background-color:#f6f8fa"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-text codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 1: Extract all words from all verses (already in correct order)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">words = verses.flatMap(verse =&gt; verse.words)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain" style="display:inline-block"></span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 2: Group words by page and line (order is preserved)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">lines = groupBy(words, word =&gt; `page-${page_number}-line-${line_number}`)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Result: { &quot;page-1-line-1&quot;: [words], &quot;page-1-line-2&quot;: [words], ... }</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain" style="display:inline-block"></span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 3: Render each line, then render words within each line</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">for each line in lines:</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">    for each word in line:</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">        render word with font based on page_number</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" title="Copy" class="clean-btn"><span class="copyButtonIcons_eSgA" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="copyButtonIcon_y97N" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path id="️-important-do-not-store-files-locally">⚠️ Important: Do Not Store Files Locally<a class="hash-link" href="#️-important-do-not-store-files-locally" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><blockquote><p><strong>We strongly recommend against downloading and storing font files, JSON data, or other assets locally in your application.</strong></p><p><strong>Why?</strong></p><ul><li>Font files and data are periodically updated with corrections, improvements, and new features</li><li>Locally stored files will become outdated without your knowledge</li><li>You may end up serving incorrect or stale Quranic content to your users</li></ul><p><strong>Best Practice:</strong> Always load fonts and data directly from the CDN at runtime. The CDN is fast, reliable, and ensures your users always receive the latest, most accurate content.</p></blockquote><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="layout-behavior-changes">Layout Behavior Changes<a class="hash-link" href="#layout-behavior-changes" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>When implementing a Reading View that aims to replicate physical Mushaf pages, consider these layout behaviors:</p><h4 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="maintaining-mushaf-page-boundaries">Maintaining Mushaf Page Boundaries<a class="hash-link" href="#maintaining-mushaf-page-boundaries" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h4><p>At smaller font scales (1-3), you can maintain <strong>physical Mushaf page boundaries</strong>:</p><ul><li>Each line matches the same boundaries as the physical Mushaf</li><li>Page breaks align with printed Mushaf pages</li><li>Words don&#x27;t overflow their designated line positions</li></ul><p>This creates an interleaved reading experience that closely mirrors reading from a physical Quran.</p><h4 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="big-text-layout-mode">Big Text Layout Mode<a class="hash-link" href="#big-text-layout-mode" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h4><p>At larger font scales (4+), it becomes impossible to maintain exact print fidelity. Consider switching to a relaxed layout:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th>Normal Layout (Scale 1-3)</th><th>Big Text Layout (Scale 4+)</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Line boundaries</td><td>Strictly maintained</td><td>Relaxed for readability</td></tr><tr><td>Page fidelity</td><td>Matches physical Mushaf</td><td>May differ from print</td></tr><tr><td>Word wrapping</td><td>Preserves Mushaf line breaks</td><td>Allows natural wrapping</td></tr><tr><td>Primary goal</td><td>Authenticity</td><td>Accessibility</td></tr></tbody></table><p><strong>Implementation tip:</strong> Track when users select large font sizes and adjust your layout constraints accordingly:</p><div class="language-javascript codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color:#393A34;--prism-background-color:#f6f8fa"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre heading">​</a></h3><p>Quran.com supports two categories of fonts:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>Description</th><th>Fonts</th><th>Pros</th><th>Cons</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>QCF (Glyph-Based)</strong></td><td>Special glyph codes mapped to custom fonts</td><td>V1, V2, V4 (Tajweed)</td><td>Pixel-perfect Mushaf rendering</td><td>Requires per-page font loading</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Unicode</strong></td><td>Standard Arabic Unicode text</td><td>QPC Hafs, Uthmani, IndoPak</td><td>Simple to implement</td><td>Standard text rendering</td></tr></tbody></table><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="available-fonts">Available Fonts<a class="hash-link" href="#available-fonts" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><table><thead><tr><th>Font Name</th><th>API Field</th><th>Mushaf ID</th><th>Type</th><th>Best For</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>QCF V1</strong></td><td><code>code_v1</code></td><td>2</td><td>Glyph-based</td><td>Traditional Madani Mushaf look</td></tr><tr><td><strong>QCF V2</strong></td><td><code>code_v2</code></td><td>1</td><td>Glyph-based</td><td>Modern Madani Mushaf (recommended)</td></tr><tr><td><strong>QCF V4 Tajweed</strong></td><td><code>code_v2</code></td><td>19</td><td>Glyph-based</td><td>Colored Tajweed rules</td></tr><tr><td><strong>QPC anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="choosing-a-font">Choosing a Font<a class="hash-link" href="#choosing-a-font" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p><strong>Choose QCF V2 if:</strong></p><ul><li>You want pixel-perfect Mushaf rendering</li><li>You&#x27;re building a dedicated Quran app</li><li>You can handle dynamic font loading</li></ul><p><strong>Choose QPC Hafs if:</strong></p><ul><li>You want simple implementation</li><li>You&#x27;re embedding Quran verses in another app</li><li>You need quick setup</li></ul><p><strong>Choose Tajweed V4 if:</strong></p><ul><li>You want to display Tajweed color rules</li><li>You can handle additional theme complexity</li></ul><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="api-parameters-for-font-rendering">API Parameters for Font Rendering<a class="hash-link" href="#api-parameters-for-font-rendering" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><p>This section covers the specific API parameters needed for font rendering. For complete API documentation including authentication, endpoints, and general usage, see the <a href="/docs/quickstart/">Content APIs Quickstart Guide</a>.</p><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="essential-parameters">Essential Parameters<a class="hash-link" href="#essential-parameters" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><table><thead><tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>words</code></td><td>Include word-level data</td><td><code>words=true</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>word_fields</code></td><td>Which text fields to return</td><td><code>word_fields=code_v2,text_qpc_hafs,text_uthmani_simple</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>mushaf</code></td><td>Mushaf layout/format ID</td><td><code>mushaf=1</code> (QCF V2)</td></tr><tr><td><code>translations</code></td><td>Translation resource IDs to include</td><td><code>translations=131,95</code> (comma-separated)</td></tr></tbody></table><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="word-fields-for-font-rendering">Word Fields for Font Rendering<a class="hash-link" href="#word-fields-for-font-rendering" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The key word fields needed for font rendering:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Description</th><th>Required For</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>code_v1</code></td><td>QCF V1 glyph codes</td><td>V1 font rendering</td></tr><tr><td><code>code_v2</code></td><td>QCF V2 glyph codes</td><td>V2 or V4 font rendering</td></tr><tr><td><code>text_qpc_hafs</code></td><td>QPC Hafs Unicode text</td><td>Unicode font rendering</td></tr><tr><td><code>text_indopak</code></td><td>IndoPak script text</td><td>IndoPak font rendering</td></tr></tbody></table><p>📚 <strong>Full field reference:</strong> <a href="https://api-docs.quran.foundation/docs/api/field-reference/#-word-level-fields-word_fields" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Word-level Fields Documentation</a></p><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="understanding-character-types">Understanding Character Types<a class="hash-link" href="#understanding-character-types" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>Each word in the API response has a <code>char_type_name</code> field indicating its type:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>Description</th><th>Rendering Notes</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>word</code></td><td>Regular Quranic word</td><td>Standard rendering</td></tr><tr><td><code>end</code></td><td>Verse end marker (۝)</td><td>Always use<code>UthmanicHafs</code> font</td></tr><tr><td><code>pause</code></td><td>Pause/stop mark</td><td>May skip rendering in some views</td></tr><tr><td><code>sajdah</code></td><td>Prostration marker</td><td>Special styling may apply</td></tr><tr><td><code>rub-el-hizb</code></td><td>Quarter Hizb marker</td><td>Special styling may apply</td></tr></tbody></table><blockquote><p>⚠️ <strong>Important:</strong> For <code>end</code> markers, always use the Unicode font (<code>UthmanicHafs</code>), not QCF fonts,
docs/legal/evidence/source_pages/api-docs.quran.foundation_docs_tutorials_fonts_font-rendering_.html:26:as the verse number glyphs render better with the Unicode font.</p></blockquote><h3 id="view-modes-reading-view-vs-translation-view">View Modes: Reading View vs Translation View<a class="hash-link" href="#view-modes-reading-view-vs-translation-view" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>When building a Quran application, you&#x27;ll typically implement one of two view modes:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th>Reading View</th><th>Translation View</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>Layout Unit</strong></td><td>Mushaf page (lines)</td><td>Single verse</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Data Grouping</strong></td><td>Words → Lines → Pages</td><td>Verses (no grouping)</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Line Construction</strong></td><td>Required</td><td>Not applicable</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Use Case</strong></td><td>Physical Mushaf layout</td><td>Study with translations</td></tr></tbody></table><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="reading-view-from-api-response-to-rendered-page">Reading View: From API Response to Rendered Page<a class="hash-link" href="#reading-view-from-api-response-to-rendered-page" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The API returns <strong>verses</strong>, but Reading View needs <strong>lines</strong> to match the physical Mushaf layout.</p><p><strong>Why?</strong> A single Mushaf line often contains words from multiple verses. You must group by line, not by verse.</p><p><strong>Word Layout Properties:</strong></p><p>Each word includes:</p><ul><li><code>page_number</code>: Which Mushaf page (1-604)</li><li><code>line_number</code>: Which line on that page (1-15 typically)</li><li><code>position</code>: Word order within the verse</li></ul><blockquote><p><strong>Note:</strong> The API returns words in correct Mushaf order, so no sorting is needed—just group by line.</p></blockquote><p><strong>Data Transformation (Pseudo-code):</strong></p><div class="language-text codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block" style="--prism-color:#393A34;--prism-background-color:#f6f8fa"><div class="codeBlockContent_biex"><pre tabindex="0" class="prism-code language-text codeBlock_bY9V thin-scrollbar"><code class="codeBlockLines_e6Vv"><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 1: Extract all words from all verses (already in correct order)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">words = verses.flatMap(verse =&gt; verse.words)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain" style="display:inline-block"></span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Step 2: Group words by page and line (order is preserved)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">lines = groupBy(words, word =&gt; `page-${page_number}-line-${line_number}`)</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">// Result: { &quot;page-1-line-1&quot;: [words], &quot;page-1-line-2&quot;: [words], ... }</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain" style="display:inline-block"></span><br></span><span class="token plain">for each line in lines:</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">    for each word in line:</span><br></span><span class="token-line" style="color:#393A34"><span class="token plain">        render word with font based on page_number</span><br></span></code></pre><div class="buttonGroup__atx"><button type="button" id="️-important-do-not-store-files-locally">⚠️ Important: Do Not Store Files Locally<a class="hash-link" href="#️-important-do-not-store-files-locally" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><blockquote><p><strong>We strongly recommend against downloading and storing font files, JSON data, or other assets locally in your application.</strong></p><p><strong>Why?</strong></p><ul><li>Font files and data are periodically updated with corrections, improvements, and new features</li><li>Locally stored files will become outdated without your knowledge</li><li>You may end up serving incorrect or stale Quranic content to your users</li></ul><p><strong>Best Practice:</strong> Always load fonts and data directly from the CDN at runtime. The CDN is fast, reliable, and ensures your users always receive the latest, most accurate content.</p></blockquote><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="layout-behavior-changes">Layout Behavior Changes<a class="hash-link" href="#layout-behavior-changes" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>When implementing a Reading View that aims to replicate physical Mushaf pages, consider these layout behaviors:</p><h4 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="maintaining-mushaf-page-boundaries">Maintaining Mushaf Page Boundaries<a class="hash-link" href="#maintaining-mushaf-page-boundaries" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h4><p>At smaller font scales (1-3), you can maintain <strong>physical Mushaf page boundaries</strong>:</p><ul><li>Each line matches the same boundaries as the physical Mushaf</li><li>Page breaks align with printed Mushaf pages</li><li>Words don&#x27;t overflow their designated line positions</li></ul><p>This creates an interleaved reading experience that closely mirrors reading from a physical Quran.</p><h4 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="big-text-layout-mode">Big Text Layout Mode<a class="hash-link" href="#big-text-layout-mode" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h4><p>At larger font scales (4+), it becomes impossible to maintain exact print fidelity. Consider switching to a relaxed layout:</p><table><thead><tr><th>Aspect</th><th>Normal Layout (Scale 1-3)</th><th>Big Text Layout (Scale 4+)</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Line boundaries</td><td>Strictly maintained</td><td>Relaxed for readability</td></tr><tr><td>Page fidelity</td><td>Matches physical Mushaf</td><td>May differ from print</td></tr><tr><td>Word wrapping</td><td>Preserves Mushaf line breaks</td><td>Allows natural wrapping</td></tr><tr><td>Primary goal</td><td>Authenticity</td><td>Accessibility</td></tr></tbody></table><p><strong>Implementation tip:</strong> Track when users select large font sizes and adjust your layout constraints fontName,\n          `url('${CDN_BASE}/fonts/quran/hafs/v2/woff2/p${pageNumber}.woff2')`\n        );\n        fontFace.display = 'block';\n        await fontFace.load();\n class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="introduction">Introduction<a class="hash-link" href="#introduction" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="what-is-the-pages-lookup-api">What is the Pages Lookup API?<a class="hash-link" href="#what-is-the-pages-lookup-api" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The Pages Lookup API provides information about how Quranic content is paginated across different Mushaf (Quran print) editions. Since different Mushafs have different page layouts, the same verse can appear on different pages depending on which Mushaf you&#x27;re using.</p><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="why-is-this-important">Why is This Important?<a class="hash-link" href="#why-is-this-important" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><ul><li><strong>Accurate Navigation</strong>: Navigate to specific Mushaf pages correctly</li><li><strong>Consistent Display</strong>: Show page numbers that match physical copies</li><li><strong>Mushaf Variety</strong>: Support multiple Mushaf styles (IndoPak, Uthmani, etc.)</li><li><strong>Reading Progress</strong>: Track reading progress by actual Mushaf pages</li></ul><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="tldr---quick-decision-guide">TL;DR - Quick Decision Guide<a class="hash-link" href="#tldr---quick-decision-guide" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><table><thead><tr><th>You Want To...</th><th>Use This Endpoint</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Get pages for a chapter</td><td><code>/pages/lookup?chapter_number=2&amp;mushaf=1</code></td><td>Al-Baqarah in QCF V2</td></tr><tr><td>Get pages for a Juz</td><td><code>/pages/lookup?juz_number=1&amp;mushaf=1</code></td><td>Juz 1</td></tr><tr><td>Get verses for a specific page</td><td><code>/verses/by_page/50?mushaf=1</code></td><td>Page 50</td></tr><tr><td>Get verse range on a page</td><td>Use Pages Lookup response</td><td>See examples</td></tr></tbody></table><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="quick-start">Quick Start<a class="hash-link" href="#quick-start" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="1-choose-your-mushaf">1. class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="introduction">Introduction<a class="hash-link" href="#introduction" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="what-is-the-pages-lookup-api">What is the Pages Lookup API?<a class="hash-link" href="#what-is-the-pages-lookup-api" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><p>The Pages Lookup API provides information about how Quranic content is paginated across different Mushaf (Quran print) editions. Since different Mushafs have different page layouts, the same verse can appear on different pages depending on which Mushaf you&#x27;re using.</p><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="why-is-this-important">Why is This Important?<a class="hash-link" href="#why-is-this-important" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><ul><li><strong>Accurate Navigation</strong>: Navigate to specific Mushaf pages correctly</li><li><strong>Consistent Display</strong>: Show page numbers that match physical copies</li><li><strong>Mushaf Variety</strong>: Support multiple Mushaf styles (IndoPak, Uthmani, etc.)</li><li><strong>Reading Progress</strong>: Track reading progress by actual Mushaf pages</li></ul><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="tldr---quick-decision-guide">TL;DR - Quick Decision Guide<a class="hash-link" href="#tldr---quick-decision-guide" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><table><thead><tr><th>You Want To...</th><th>Use This Endpoint</th><th>Example</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Get pages for a chapter</td><td><code>/pages/lookup?chapter_number=2&amp;mushaf=1</code></td><td>Al-Baqarah in QCF V2</td></tr><tr><td>Get pages for a Juz</td><td><code>/pages/lookup?juz_number=1&amp;mushaf=1</code></td><td>Juz 1</td></tr><tr><td>Get verses for a specific page</td><td><code>/verses/by_page/50?mushaf=1</code></td><td>Page 50</td></tr><tr><td>Get verse range on a page</td><td>Use Pages Lookup response</td><td>See examples</td></tr></tbody></table><hr><h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="quick-start">Quick Start<a class="hash-link" href="#quick-start" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h2><h3 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_LWe7" id="1-choose-your-mushaf">1. Choose Your Mushaf<a class="hash-link" href="#1-choose-your-mushaf" title="Direct link to heading">​</a></h3><div class="language-javascript codeBlockContainer_Ckt0 theme-code-block"
